resources.string:
This service allows triggering emergency SOS by holding the Volume Up button for 6 seconds, even when the phone screen is off or locked. This helps you activate emergency alerts discreetly in dangerous situations.

The service:
• Detects Volume Up button press
• Works when screen is OFF/LOCKED
• Sends location, photos, and audio to emergency contacts
• Provides vibration feedback

No data is collected or shared. The service only activates when you hold Volume Up for 6 seconds.
